# AsOf

> AsOf is an open-source, time-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system for Indian GST law. It answers "what was the rule on date X?" by storing the period each notification, circular and provision was in force, following amendment and supersession chains, and citing the exact source text.

Key facts:

- Domain: Indian Goods and Services Tax (CGST Act 2017, CGST Rules 2017, CBIC Central Tax notifications, CBIC circulars).
- Core idea: every text chunk has a validity date range `[valid_from, valid_to)`; retrieval uses only text in force on the requested as-of date.
- Stack: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector (halfvec, HNSW, full-text search, daterange), NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 models (LLM and embeddings) via the NVIDIA API catalog, Nemotron 3.5 Rerank 8B via OpenRouter with an LLM fallback.
- Hosting: Render (API) and Neon (database), free tiers, Singapore region.
- Status: working prototype over 337 CBIC notifications and circulars (2019-2022): ingestion, amendment-relation extraction, validity resolution, date-filtered hybrid search, reranking, grounded answers with verified quotes, web UI.
- Results (49-question benchmark, vs a standard RAG with the same models): answer accuracy 64.1% vs 38.5%; recall@1 59.0% vs 20.5%; stale-source rate 0% vs 28.6%; abstention accuracy 89.8% vs 69.4%. Small set; 29 questions were generated from AsOf's own extracted version chains.
- Not legal or tax advice.
